title: GNPTAB-Related Disorders
result: Expert-authored, peer-reviewed chapter, first posted 2008, comprehensive update 13 August 2026. GNPTAB encodes the alpha and beta subunits of N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphotransferase, which synthesises the mannose 6-phosphate recognition marker that sorts newly synthesised lysosomal enzymes from the Golgi apparatus to lysosomes; the p.Lys4Gln variant impairs retention of the enzyme in the Golgi complex. Defective enzyme causes mis-sorting of lysosomal enzymes and accumulation of nondegradable macromolecules in lysosomes; complete loss of activity gives mucolipidosis II alpha/beta and residual activity of 1-10% usually mucolipidosis III alpha/beta.
